_about: Art directions for landing page mockups. Each one is a complete visual position, not a color swap. axes are used to keep a set of 2-3 directions genuinely different: type (serif | grotesk | mono | condensed | humanist), value (light | dark | color), layout (editorial | grid | bands | collage | canvas | gallery), imagery (photo | illustration | product-ui | type | render | paper). kinds lists the product kinds a direction suits (software | physical | service | content | event); a brief's kind filters the pool.

directions.name: Warm editorial
directions.paletteWords: cream paper background, warm near-black ink, one rust accent used for links and a single button
directions.type: a high-contrast serif for headlines set large with tight leading, a quiet humanist sans for body text, small caps for labels
directions.layout: asymmetric two-column hero with the headline on the left and a tall photographic plate on the right, hairline rules between sections, wide outer margins, one full-width image band in the middle of the page
directions.imagery: natural-light still-life photography with real texture (paper, wood, linen), shot from slightly above
directions.heroVisual: a tall natural-light photograph of {subject}, framed like a magazine plate with a thin caption underneath
directions.featureLayout: one large feature with a cropped product screenshot spanning two columns, followed by two smaller text-led features with short captions

proofLayout.quotes: a single large pull quote in serif italic with the person's name and role in small caps
proofLayout.facts: a row of three plain facts set in large serif numerals or short phrases, separated by hairline rules

directions.pricingLayout: plans set as a calm table with hairline dividers, the recommended plan marked by a small rust label rather than a colored card

directions.name: Swiss grid
directions.paletteWords: white page, black type, pale grey modules, a single signal red-orange used only for the primary button and key numbers
directions.type: a neutral grotesk set very large and flush left for headlines, the same family in regular weight for body, small monospaced captions
directions.layout: a visible 12-column grid, flush-left headline spanning eight columns, square-cornered modules of different widths, captions aligned to the grid, no centered blocks
directions.imagery: the product interface shown at true scale inside plain rectangular frames, with real labels and numbers
directions.heroVisual: a wide, true-scale screenshot of {subject} in a plain rectangular frame that bleeds off the right edge
directions.featureLayout: an asymmetric module grid: one wide module with a product crop, two narrow modules with a number and a sentence each

proofLayout.quotes: one short quote in a narrow grid column next to the person's name and company in mono
proofLayout.facts: three large numerals or short facts with one-line labels, sitting on the grid

directions.pricingLayout: plans as columns of a ruled comparison table with the recommended column outlined in black

directions.name: Dark instrument panel
directions.paletteWords: near-black graphite page, warm off-white text, one phosphor-lime accent reserved for live data and the primary button, 1px hairline borders
directions.type: a monospaced face for labels, numbers and code, a compact grotesk for headlines in medium weight, nothing bold
directions.layout: a wide product canvas directly under a short headline, dense panels with real numbers, code samples in bordered blocks, sections separated by thin rules rather than color changes
directions.imagery: the real product interface and terminal output; at most one macro photograph of hardware
directions.heroVisual: a wide dark interface of {subject} with live charts, logs and status rows, framed edge to edge
directions.featureLayout: a split layout alternating code block and live interface panel, each with a two-line explanation

proofLayout.quotes: one short quote set in mono inside a bordered panel
proofLayout.facts: a log-style list of facts, each line prefixed with a small status mark and a timestamp

directions.pricingLayout: plans as bordered panels with usage limits in mono, the recommended one with a lime top rule

directions.name: Color-block poster
directions.paletteWords: flat butter-yellow, tomato red and cobalt fields in full-width bands, black type, no gradients
directions.type: an extra-bold condensed sans in uppercase for headlines, set huge and tight, a sturdy sans for body
directions.layout: full-width color bands, each section a different flat color, oversized numbers, sticker-style labels set at slight angles, generous black outlines
directions.imagery: flat cut-paper illustrations with visible paper edges, two or three colors each
directions.heroVisual: a large flat cut-paper illustration of {subject} overlapping the headline block
directions.featureLayout: alternating left-right bands, each with one illustration and one big statement

proofLayout.quotes: two or three short quotes on sticker labels across a colored band
proofLayout.facts: a colored band with three oversized statements on sticker labels

directions.pricingLayout: plans as thick-outlined cards on a colored band, the recommended card rotated two degrees

directions.name: Soft photographic
directions.paletteWords: soft off-white, deep moss-green accent, earthy neutrals taken from the photography
directions.type: a rounded humanist sans for headlines in semibold, the same family for body, comfortable line length
directions.layout: a full-bleed photographic hero with the headline on a calm area of the photo, then alternating photo and text bands with large rounded image crops
directions.imagery: natural-light documentary photography of real places and hands using the product, no posed stock smiles
directions.heroVisual: a full-bleed natural-light photograph of {subject}, with a calm, uncluttered area for the headline
directions.featureLayout: three alternating photo-and-text rows with different crop shapes

proofLayout.quotes: two longer quotes with small portraits and full names, set beside a wide photo
proofLayout.facts: three short facts set beside a wide photograph, each with a small line drawing

directions.pricingLayout: two or three soft cards on a white band, the recommended one with a moss outline

directions.name: Paper collage
directions.paletteWords: textured kraft and cream papers, ink black, a red pencil accent and a blue ballpoint accent
directions.type: a soft old-style serif for headlines, a typewriter-like mono for labels, handwritten annotations used sparingly
directions.layout: overlapping paper pieces, taped photos and cards at slight angles, margin notes with hand-drawn arrows, but body text kept on straight, readable paper
directions.imagery: scanned paper textures, cut-out photographs with white borders, hand-drawn marker marks
directions.heroVisual: a collage of torn paper, a taped photograph of {subject} and a handwritten note
directions.featureLayout: index cards pinned at different angles, each holding one feature with a small cut-out image

proofLayout.quotes: quotes handwritten on paper scraps with names, pinned around a short headline
proofLayout.facts: facts typed on index cards and taped at slight angles

directions.pricingLayout: plans as paper tickets with perforated edges, the recommended one stamped

directions.name: Mono document
directions.paletteWords: plain off-white page, black monospaced text, a single blue for links like a well-kept document
directions.type: a monospaced face for everything except a slightly larger proportional headline, strict sizes, no bold except headings
directions.layout: a single narrow reading column like a README, with wide inline code blocks and diagrams breaking out of the column, ASCII-style separators
directions.imagery: code samples, terminal captures and simple line diagrams; no photographs
directions.heroVisual: a terminal or code block showing {subject} in use, set right under the headline
directions.featureLayout: a numbered list in prose, each item with a short code or output sample

proofLayout.quotes: a quote set as a block quote with the author's handle
proofLayout.facts: a plain bulleted list of facts, like a README

directions.pricingLayout: a simple text table with plan, price and limits

directions.name: Studio product
directions.paletteWords: a seamless warm clay studio backdrop, black type, accent is the product's own color
directions.type: a tight grotesk in heavy weight for big two-line headlines, small medium-weight body
directions.layout: a centered product render dominating the hero, then modular tiles with macro detail crops of materials and parts, specs in a clean two-column list
directions.imagery: studio product photography or renders on seamless paper with one soft key light and a real contact shadow
directions.heroVisual: a studio photograph of {subject} on a seamless clay backdrop with one soft key light
directions.featureLayout: a bento of macro detail crops, each with a two-word label and one line

proofLayout.quotes: two review excerpts with the reviewer's name in small type
proofLayout.facts: a row of honest spec numbers with units

directions.pricingLayout: configurations shown as product variants with prices, not SaaS cards
notFor: pure software without a physical form

directions.name: Type-led statement
directions.paletteWords: black page, bone-white type, one hot orange used for a single word per section
directions.type: a very large grotesk in mixed weights, some headline words in italic or a contrasting serif, massive size contrast between headline and body
directions.layout: each section led by one oversized statement that runs edge to edge, short supporting text in a narrow column, minimal imagery, strong vertical rhythm changes
directions.imagery: almost none: typography carries the page, with one small product crop where needed
directions.heroVisual: only typography: the headline set across the full width, with one small crop of {subject} tucked into the line
directions.featureLayout: three stacked statements, each with a one-line explanation and a tiny product crop

proofLayout.quotes: one huge quote across the full width with the attribution in small type
proofLayout.facts: one huge statement per fact, stacked, each followed by a small line of detail

directions.pricingLayout: plans as large type lines with price set at the same size as the plan name
notFor: products that need to show a lot of interface

directions.name: Ink and lamplight
directions.paletteWords: deep warm brown-black, parchment-colored text, a single lamp-amber accent
directions.type: a book serif for headlines and body, generous leading, italics for emphasis, small spaced capitals for labels
directions.layout: a quiet centered reading column for text, with wide low-key photographs that break out to full width, lots of dark space
directions.imagery: low-light photography lit by a single warm lamp, real shadows
directions.heroVisual: a low-light photograph of {subject} lit by a single warm desk lamp
directions.featureLayout: two wide photographs, each followed by a short paragraph and a small product crop

proofLayout.quotes: one long quote in italic serif with the person's name
proofLayout.facts: three short facts in italic serif, separated by thin amber rules

directions.pricingLayout: two plans described in sentences with prices, separated by a thin amber rule
